scenes.line1: How do you keep your code safe?
scenes.say: How do you keep your code safe in Git? What actually makes a commit secure?

scenes.label: Signed
scenes.sub: GPG-signed commits prove the author is legit.
scenes.say: Signed commits use G-P-G to verify who actually made the change. It's proof the author is legit.
Protected branches lock down your main code. Only admins can push, force-push is blocked, and merges need approval.

scenes.title: Remove secrets from history
scenes.say: If you accidentally commit secrets, use git filter-branch to wipe them from your history. Just deleting the file isn't enough.

scenes.question: Is deleting a file enough to remove a secret?
scenes.right: No, you must scrub it from all history.
scenes.say: Trap: Is deleting a file enough to remove a secret? Nope. You have to scrub it from your entire history, or it's still exposed.
